content_fields.title: Use a secure authentication mechanism for database connections
content_fields.description: Use a secure authentication mechanism for database connections generally.
content_fields.guidance: Connections should authenticate with scram-sha-256, client certificates or short-lived credentials issued by a secret store, rather than a static password shared between environments.
content_fields.found: A static password is passed through the environment and used for every connection.
content_fields.missing: A secret store capable of issuing short-lived database credentials, and server support for the chosen method.
content_fields.conclusion: Moving to certificate or dynamically issued credentials requires infrastructure the deployment does not yet have.
content_fields.action: The database administration and platform teams should select and roll out the stronger mechanism.
